fields.description: Issue dated December 29, 1928 (Vol. 5, no. 13) of Miami Life, published in Miami, Florida. Includes editorials and commentary on South Florida’s post-boom financial strain (including bond payments and the realty market), crime and law enforcement (including discussion of bondsmen/fixers and a coroner’s jury verdict in a Hialeah shooting), and public safety concerns about automobile accidents. Reports on the selection of the old Central School site for a new Miami post office. Contains extensive local entertainment and nightlife listings and promotions (theaters, clubs, New Year’s Eve events), including notices related to greyhound racing and other sports, along with society-style columns and advertisements.
